work_info.title: What is Automobile Image Editing?
descriptions: Automobile Image Editing is the professional enhancement of vehicle photographs to create clean, detailed, and visually appealing visuals for modern buyers. It improves image quality while maintaining accuracy, helping dealerships and automotive businesses build trust and attract attention online.

list.content: Color & Paint Enhancement: Refining tones and reflections to highlight the vehicle’s finish.
Background Cleanup & Replacement: Removing distractions for a focused, professional look.
Detail Sharpening: Enhancing headlights, interiors, wheels, and key features.
Shadow & Reflection Balancing: Adding depth while maintaining realistic lighting.
Marketplace-Ready Optimization: Preparing images for automotive websites, listings, and ads.
